product_updates.title: SpaceX has bought $329M worth of Tesla Megapacks so far this year
product_updates.content: The purchase illustrates just how interconnected Elon Musk's universe of companies are.

product_updates.title: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
product_updates.content: A new SaferAI report finds Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.2 approaches frontier AI capabilities while lacking key safety mitigations, renewing concerns that powerful open models could outpace governance and safeguards.

product_updates.title: Anthropic signs $10B deal with AI cloud startup Volta
product_updates.content: Anthropic has been on a cloud partnership spree in recent months, and its latest move is reportedly a $10 billion deal with AI cloud startup Volta.

product_updates.title: Meet Wrinkles, an app that uncovers the hidden stories of the places around you
product_updates.content: Wrinkles, available on both iOS and Android, essentially acts as an AI-powered audio tour guide that reveals hidden history and local stories.

product_updates.title: Nvidia doesn’t mess around: A week after open AI industry group formed, it’s already showing progress
product_updates.content: The week-old Open Secure AI Alliance, spearheaded by Nvidia and grown to over 120 companies, already has proposals out for defending against AI agents.

product_updates.title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
product_updates.content: Spotify says Merlin, which represents more than 30,000 independent labels and distributors, has joined Universal Music Group in backing its upcoming AI-powered remix and covers product. product_updates.title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
product_updates.content: Tech companies and developers have been scouring the U.S. for places to build data centers, and they’ve been drawn to Texas’ loose regulations and seemingly abundant power supply. But even Texas can be pushed to the brink.

product_updates.title: Elon Musk spends half his time talking robots and AI on Tesla earnings calls
product_updates.content: An analysis of the last seven years of Tesla earnings calls shows just how little attention Musk pays to Tesla's car business.

product_updates.title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
product_updates.content: Apple says its trade secrets investigation into OpenAI has widened. In a new court filing, Apple claims additional former staff may have retained or accessed confidential information.

product_updates.title: Is the future of data centers portable? Runware builds a pod to find out
product_updates.content: On Tuesday, AI infrastructure company Runware announced the launch of its own modular data center called Sonic Inference Pod.
